name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context of the conversation and the preceding statements.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the conversation, ensuring that responses follow logically from the previous messages.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the degree to which the response encourages further discussion or interaction, indicating a willingness to continue the conversation.

name: Originality
description: Judges the uniqueness of the responses, assessing if they provide new perspectives or insights rather than repeating common knowledge or phrases.

name: Tone Appropriateness
description: Measures how well the tone of the response matches the context of the conversation, ensuring it aligns with the mood and subject matter.
